title: 付费 API 的执行前预算防线
summary: 在付费请求发出前估算工作量与成本并执行 token/USD 预算；完成批次和 checkpoint 保持可复用；实际 provider usage 仍是权威事实。
rules: Projected over-budget work SHOULD be stopped before the paid request is sent.
Completed batches/checkpoints SHOULD remain reusable after a budget stop.
Actual provider usage is authoritative; estimates MUST remain labeled heuristic.
Unknown provider pricing MUST NOT silently inherit unrelated pricing assumptions.
